snapshot.title: Harwick PD: Drone Sighting at Birch Hollow Range — 08:50

transcript.speaker: Officer M. Delgado
transcript.text: This is Officer M. Delgado from Harwick PD. We received a 911 call from a neighbor at the Birch Hollow Range. They reported seeing a drone with a red light on, hovering near the test site fence at 08:50. They said it looked like it was scanning the area, and the light was flashing fast. We’re sending a unit to the site now, but we need to know if your team is aware of any unauthorized operations or if this could be a security breach.

transcript.speaker: Security / Campus Safety Liaison
transcript.text: We’re aware of a system-wide cyber incident. All UAS are grounded. GCS-02 was offline and isolated at 08:50. No authorized flights were in progress. We’ll confirm the site status and send an update.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker's external reconnaissance window. The security team must verify that no flight was active and that the drone sighting aligns with GCS-02's compromised timeline. Watch for over-communication or attempts to override the hold on operations.
